bias_targets.methodology: Counting gender-related identity keywords in audio transcripts and calculating pointwise mutual information (PMI) to identify stereotypical word associations with gendered terms.
Calculating and comparing the total duration (in hours) of English versus non-English audio data to assess linguistic representation across datasets.
Counting race- and ethnicity-related identity keywords in audio transcripts to assess representation, and detecting the prevalence of racist terms and slurs using profanity lists.
Counting sexual orientation-related identity keywords in audio transcripts and analyzing the presence of queerphobic terms, slurs, and homophobic stereotypes.
Counting religion-related identity keywords (e.g., 'Muslim', 'Christian', 'Jewish') in audio transcripts to assess representation disparities.
